finding: Signup username uniqueness is not enforced by current production profile constraints

constraints.name: profiles_admin_assigned_by_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (admin_assigned_by) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: profiles_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

sourceEvidence.signupUI: screens/SignUpScreen.tsx: username regex and username-taken alerts
sourceEvidence.registration: store/auth.ts: register passes username metadata directly to Supabase signup
sourceEvidence.apple: store/auth.ts: Apple fullName persists into profiles.username
sourceEvidence.availability: public.is_username_available uses case-insensitive lookup; no current client call found

decisionPending: Unique handles with separate display names, or shared display names without uniqueness promise
scope: Rolled-back synthetic auth.users/profile-trigger probe, not full signup HTTP/email delivery. No customer names read or changed. Four duplicate nonblank normalized groups counted without returning identifiers.
